text:
zoe-support: Customer reports a 402 billing error inside our app. They only attached a screenshot of the error text and say "no correlation id visible". What's the minimal set we should ask them to send so we can triage fast?

ingrid-cs: Minimal triage checklist (copy/paste to customer):
- Account/org id (the numeric Org ID shown in Console)
- UTC timestamp of the failing request (to the second if possible)
- Response headers or a HAR export from the time of failure
- If HAR not available, a minimal curl reproducer plus full HTTP response headers
- SDK debug logs (if they used an SDK)

Also tell them where to find a correlation id in Console: Console -> Billing -> Requests -> click the row -> Copy correlation id. If they only have a screenshot of the UI error message, it's not enough. We need headers or network logs.

zoe-support: Nice. Can you give an actual curl example I can paste?

sam-dev: Paste this minimal example for them to run (it prints response headers):

```
# minimal reproducible curl (prints headers + body)
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"healthcheck"}'

# look for headers (case-insensitive):
# X-Redwood-Request-Id: <alphanumeric>
# X-Redwood-Corr-Id: <uuid-like>
```

sam-dev: If they used the JS SDK, ask them to enable debug logs and send lines that include `redwood:request_id` or `redwood:corr_id`. Example snippet:

```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.KEY, debug: true });
// will log: redwood:request_id=<id> or redwood:corr_id=<id>
```

ingrid-cs: If customer cannot run curl or export HAR, ask them to: 1) open devtools/network, 2) find the failed request, 3) right-click -> copy -> copy response headers (and paste). A screenshot of only the JSON error message is not enough.

zoe-support: Also remind them to redact API keys before pasting. I'll send the checklist and the curl + SDK snippets.

deploy-bot: FYI: RW-342 will add a "Copy correlation id" button to the Console next sprint.

ingrid-cs: If they reply with only a screenshot, escalate to eng immediately—include account id + timestamp and tag as high-priority so we can search logs server-side.
